_comment: The Wild Deck - 200 cards (20 unique) converted from the design-lane drop (docs/design-lane/generated/deck.json). Drawn on tile reveals at config.wild.card_chance. fate/ward cards go to the hand; encounter/loot resolve on draw. Ops are the engine vocabulary in game.gd/_apply_wild_ops. Regenerate with the converter.

cards.name: Double Down
cards.text: Bypass action locking and execute the Gather or Explore action twice this turn.

cards.name: Unshackled
cards.text: Instantly remove a 'Lock' status from your chosen action.

cards.name: Focus Shift
cards.text: Switch your chosen action this turn without paying the 1 Light cost.

cards.name: Swift Step
cards.text: Move up to 2 hexes instead of 1 on your move phase.

cards.name: Swamp Ambush
cards.text: Sinking Bog encounter. Trigger a challenge with a local Sinking Bog creature. Fail penalty: Bleed.

cards.name: Sinking Quagmire
cards.text: Drains 2 Warmth and locks your movement next turn unless a Water-type helps.

cards.name: Guardian's Whispers
cards.text: Guardian site event. Draw 1 Blessing card if your karma is positive; otherwise lose 2 Light.

cards.name: Raging Tempest
cards.text: Frost Peak event. Forces player to build a campfire or lose 3 health from cold.

cards.name: Ancient Trap
cards.text: Ancient Ruins encounter. Roll a saving challenge. Failure locks your next Craft action.

cards.name: Mirage
cards.text: Desert encounter. Turns all explored tiles face down within a 2-tile radius.

cards.name: Eclipse
cards.text: Eldritch event. Temporarily forces all wild creatures into 'Exalted Dark' aggression for 2 turns.

cards.name: Rich Loom
cards.text: Gather +3 Plant Fiber from any forest or grasslands tile this turn.

cards.name: Flint Deposit
cards.text: Gather +2 Flint from any rocky tile without using a Pickaxe.

cards.name: Luminous Algae Pool
cards.text: Wooded Lake resource. Instantly restores 3 Light and provides 2 Luminous Algae.

cards.name: Hidden Chest
cards.text: Open a chest. Draw 1 random Rare or Uncommon consumable item.

cards.name: Scrap Metal Pile
cards.text: Ancient Ruins resource. Harvest 2 Ancient Gears and 1 Copper Ore.

cards.name: Mist Ward
cards.text: Deploy a magical fog ward. Wild creatures cannot chase or spot you for 3 turns.

cards.name: Thermal Cloak Blessing
cards.text: Provides complete warmth protection from cold mountain hexes for 5 turns.

cards.name: Aura Shield
cards.text: Absorbs up to 3 damage from any hostile creature attack.

cards.name: Sanctum Key
cards.text: Bypasses the Light-gate requirements of the central Sanctum.
